title: SWGOH squad requirements
description: Definition of squad-building requirements organized into categories. A squad lists a set of required units and an optional pool of extra units; together they make up the squad of `size` units (default 5). Each unit must reach the squad's `minRelic` relic level (or a per-unit override). See squads.md for a walkthrough.

squads.description: Squads in this category. May be empty (a category can be a placeholder, e.g. 'TW').

mode.description: How relic requirements are evaluated. 'minRelic': every unit needs at least `minRelic` (hard floor). 'commonRelic': raid-style, no hard floor - the squad reports its best common relic level (highest `thresholds` value all squad units reach).

minRelic.description: Minimum relic level required for every unit in this squad (mode 'minRelic' only). 0 means 'just needs to be owned'.

thresholds.description: Relic levels that count for the best common relic level (mode 'commonRelic' only). The reported level is the highest of these that every squad unit reaches.

size.description: Final squad size. Default 5. Must equal len(required) + poolCount.

required.description: Specific units that must be in the squad. In 'minRelic' mode each needs at least the squad/unit relic; in 'commonRelic' mode they must all reach a common relic level.

oneOf.description: A specific list of optional units; `poolCount` of them are needed.

tag.description: Faction/role tag (e.g. 'Bounty Hunter', 'Jedi'); any owned character carrying the tag may fill a pool slot. Ships are excluded.

pool.description: Optional pool of extra units. Either a list of specific units or a faction tag.

poolCount.description: How many units from `pool` are required. Defaults to size - len(required).

oneOf.description: Unit display name, e.g. 'Bossk'. Uses the squad's `minRelic`.
